interpretation.requestedResult: Infer the prism material index from grazing emergence and calculate the incidence angle at minimum deviation.
stated: Isosceles prism with 45-degree apex. The emergent ray grazes the second face at 45-degree incidence.
derived: Grazing emergence is the limiting refraction angle of 90 degrees from the exit normal.
assumptions: One homogeneous exterior of index one, the direct nonnegative meridional branch, and one homogeneous prism material.
unknowns: Finite aperture and source launch position.
